sourceMatches: throw new TypeError('The current ACCDB bend formulation supports only BEND_AXIAL_SHAPE=YES.');
solverConsumption.interpretation: The current solver requires the authority setting to be YES but does not implement a distinct CAESAR axial bend shape function from that setting.

authorityObservation.statement: Hexagon identifies axial displacement of short-arched pipe as a major deformation contributor particularly for bends 45 degrees or smaller; disabling the axial shape mode makes such bends stiffer.
authorityObservation.bm4lApplicability: All twelve governed BM4_L bends are 90 degrees, so the documented strongest sensitivity range is absent in this benchmark.

decision.reason: The configuration-consumption gap is real, but the available authority does not specify the axial shape function equations and BM4_L contains no bends in the documented <=45 degree high-sensitivity range. Implementing a guessed formula would violate the no-fallback/no-fitting rule.
decision.nextInvestigation: Use source-element replay and CAESAR bend near/far-point geometry to distinguish output-location semantics from bend axial/shear stiffness before adding any new bend mechanic.
